# ListItemIcon

Icon for list item

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: ListItemIcon

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { ListItemIcon } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<ListItem>
  <ListItemIcon>
    <InboxIcon />
  </ListItemIcon>
  <ListItemText primary="Inbox" />
</ListItem>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<ListItem>
  <ListItemIcon>
    <InboxIcon />
  </ListItemIcon>
  <ListItemText primary="Inbox" />
</ListItem>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's ListItemIcon.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI ListItemIcon Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/listitemicon/)
